_note: motion-change-recommendations (mot-19, recommendation half): a text change the griffie or committee recommends for a motion, line by line, which the chair or secretary accepts or rejects without a vote. The record and its pending -> accepted / pending -> rejected lifecycle are declarative. Accepting is imperative (ChangeRecommendationService): it writes the motion text through AmendmentTextMerger and the recommendation status together, and refuses when the passage no longer occurs. Numbered 133, the next free number, not the 125 the design names.

ChangeRecommendation.title: Change recommendation
ChangeRecommendation.description: A recommended change to a range of lines of a motion's text, accepted or rejected by the chair or secretary without a vote.

motion.title: Motion
motion.description: The motion (a decision with decisionType motion) this recommendation changes.

lineFrom.title: From line
lineFrom.description: The first line of the passage, as numbered when the recommendation was made.

lineTo.title: To line
lineTo.description: The last line of the passage, as numbered when the recommendation was made.

targetPassage.title: Current text
targetPassage.description: The exact words of those lines. This, not the line numbers, is what accepting replaces.

proposedText.title: New text
proposedText.description: The recommended wording. Empty deletes the passage.

status.title: Status
status.description: pending until the chair or secretary accepts or rejects it.

decidedBy.title: Decided by
decidedBy.description: The user id of the chair or secretary who accepted or rejected it.

decidedAt.title: Decided at
decidedAt.description: When it was accepted or rejected.

x-openregister-lifecycle._note: REQ-MCR-003 and REQ-MCR-004: a recommendation is decided once. Accepting goes through POST /api/change-recommendations/{id}/accept, which also changes the motion text.
